tasha_roy: starting thread for VantageCorp POC commit. Sales needs a conservative GPU reserve + autoscale playbook for SOW. profile below.

ben_turner: traffic: steady 25 rps, bursts to 250 rps for 2-3m twice/day. avg token/req ~300, heavy tails to 1200. model: M-XL quantized.

mira_kovach: perf note: M-XL quantized ~= 11k tokens/s per A100-equivalent at 512 seq; use 10k t/s for safety.

ryan_cho: calc: steady tokens/s = 25*300=7500 -> ~0.75 GPU -> baseline 1. but bursts push need. my rec: reserved=3 (3x steady) + burst credits; keep min_gpus=1 to avoid cold penalty.

tasha_roy: can you paste a short autoscale snippet i can include in SOW and a one-line security note about preheat/KV seed?

ryan_cho: snippet: ```autoscale: reserved_gpus=3; min_gpus=1; burst_credits=1200; scale_up_if p95>350ms; preheat=kv_seed_top20% (synthetic)```

ben_turner: security one-liner: "KV preheat uses anonymized synthetic prefixes and runs within customer network boundaries for Dedicated/Private; no customer PII is uploaded."

infra-bot: preheat job template created -> id vc-preheat-1789004321.

tasha_roy: thanks all. action items: (1) ryan run quick cost sim reserve1/reserve3/by-burst (2) ben add snippet & one-liner to SOW draft. will update sales by EOD.
